hook: Your rocket engine can be one single 3D-printed piece.
title: India launched a rocket with a printed engine
description:
India's Agnikul builds rocket engines that are 3D-printed as a single piece. Its Agnibaan SOrTeD flew in 2024 from Agnikul's own private launchpad at Sriharikota. A rocket engine that starts as a printer file is now a real launch.

#Shorts #Technology #ISRO
